subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should OpenClaw add a public pre-auth content hook and automatic trusted access-request workflow, and if so must grouped sender membership reuse the canonical `accessGroups` contract rather than the PR’s parallel channel-specific group schema?
rationale: Code review can identify the duplicate contract and security implications, but it cannot decide whether blocked-message content should become a supported pre-admission API or whether trusted handlers should activate from existing allowlist configuration.

options.title: Align and split the feature
options.body: Require the grouped allowlist work to reuse canonical `accessGroups`, and review the pre-auth hook and activation policy as a narrower security-sensitive surface.

options.title: Accept the full proposed contract
options.body: Explicitly approve the new pre-auth data boundary, automatic trusted-hook activation, and separate role-like grouped-entry schema as permanent public behavior.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Close or park the PR if maintainers do not want blocked-message content hooks or role-like sender groups in core.

recommendation.title: Align and split the feature
recommendation.body: Require the grouped allowlist work to reuse canonical `accessGroups`, and review the pre-auth hook and activation policy as a narrower security-sensitive surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the shared ingress, allowlist, command-mutation, and plugin SDK boundaries that require a unified decision.
